_comment_what: THE single pin for the @talchain/schemas contract artifact used by the ISL drift check (tests/contract_drift/). The committed artifact talchain-schemas.json in this directory MUST be byte-identical to what scripts/contract_schema/refresh_contract_schema.sh regenerates from this pin — CI's contract-drift freshness gate enforces that. Change the contract snapshot ONLY by editing this file and running the refresh script; hand-editing talchain-schemas.json is exactly the hand-maintained-mirror defect this check exists to kill.
_comment_upstream: INTENDED upstream is the JSON-Schema export artifact being built on olumi-schemas branch 'a3-json-schema-publish' (draft PR, parallel A3 lane). That branch did not exist on the remote when this check was built (verified 2026-07-20, git ls-remote), so per the lane's settled fallback the artifact is generated locally from the schemas repo at the pinned ref below by scripts/contract_schema/generate_contract_schema.mjs. When the schemas PR merges and publishes, bump 'ref' here to that release tag (the brief anticipated a 0.19.x tag; main already carries package version 0.20.0, so in practice the next published tag) and, if the published artifact format differs, switch the refresh script to fetch it instead of generating.
ref_kind: commit — origin/main tip at generation time (package.json version 0.20.0)
